policy: Offline source-bound review of the declared mechanic using native 120 Hz state, applied action, and event evidence. Success means high-confidence demonstration suitable for later behavior-cloning curation. Ambiguous and failed attempts remain preserved. This is not a production detector, reward, or training label.

1ED91132-BEF2-4B18-8872-364E7893B89A.label: wavedash
1ED91132-BEF2-4B18-8872-364E7893B89A.criterion: Directional dodge at or immediately before a partial-wheel landing, followed by stable surface contact and positive tangent-speed transfer.

151E5828-251B-420D-8798-EE14B3A204C5.label: zapdash
151E5828-251B-420D-8798-EE14B3A204C5.criterion: Jump onset from the required non-flat landing support topology followed by the zapdash landing/dodge sequence and positive tangent-speed transfer.

attempt_notes.*: No attempt has source-exact evidence for the required zapdash support topology. Some contain landing-dash motion, so they are retained as ambiguous rather than promoted to behavior-cloning success.
